# War Scroll Column 10 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 10 | **Condition:** complete

---

**1** "Who is like You, God of Israel, in heaven or on earth? What god can match Your mighty acts or rival Your immense power?

**2** And who can compare to Your people Israel, whom You chose from every nation on earth — a people set apart by Your covenant, trained in Your law,

**3** granted wisdom and insight, privileged to hear Your glorious voice and see Your holy angels, with ears open to deep mysteries and eyes that perceive the movements of the stars?

**4** Who could ever measure the vastness of Your wonders? Who could begin to count them? Your glorious purpose — who could ever grasp it?

**5** You made the earth and determined its zones — desert and fertile plain — and everything that grows from the soil.

**6** You made the ocean currents, the converging rivers, the deep chasms of the abyss, every animal and bird, the human form, and all the generations descending from Adam.

**7** You caused the division of languages and the scattering of peoples. You assigned the territories of the clans and the boundaries of nations. You set the sacred calendar, the cycle of years, and the unfolding ages of eternity.

**8** You created human speech; You knew every word before it was spoken and determined what every mouth would say. You measured out language itself and portioned out the very breath of speech.

**9** You set the stars in motion according to their hidden laws, guided them along their courses, assigned the storm winds their tasks, and gave lightning and thunder their roles.

**10** You filled the vaults with snow and the storehouses with hail. You created frost, rain, dew, and mist, the shapes of the clouds, and the shimmering colors of the rainbow.

**11** The holy spirits of truth and the mighty angels serve in Your presence and walk in the radiance of Your glory. You appointed them as powerful members of Your divine council.

**12** The very foundations of the world shake at Your glory, and all Your awe-inspiring mysteries — the mighty deeds of Your power — make the earth tremble before You.

**13** Rise up, Mighty Warrior! Seize Your prisoners, Glorious God! Carry off Your plunder, Champion of Valor! Place Your hand on the necks of Your enemies

**14** and plant Your foot on the heaped-up corpses! Crush the hostile nations and let Your sword feast on guilty flesh!

**15** Fill Your land with splendor and Your inheritance with prosperity! Let cattle overflow in Your meadows, and let silver, gold, and jewels fill Your palaces!

**16** Celebrate with all your heart, O Zion! Break out in joyful song, O Jerusalem! Shout for joy, every town in Judah! Throw open your gates wide

**17** so that the riches of the nations may pour in! Their kings will serve you, and every oppressor will grovel at your feet and lick the dust beneath your sandals!"

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 10 is a magnificent war hymn, well preserved. The "Who is like You?" opening (echoing Exodus 15:11) leads into a sweeping creation catalogue that establishes God's cosmic authority. The final section (lines 13-17) is a passionate invocation of God as warrior, culminating in Zion's triumph over the nations — drawing on Isaiah 60 and Zechariah 9:9. Language heightened throughout for liturgical impact.*
